participant_id.Description: BIDS label = patient label of the release file name (memact_trials_P<N>.mat)

source_id.Description: Patient label in the release and in Supplementary Table S1 of Moraresku et al. 2025

age.Description: Age in years (Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Supplementary Table S1). Cohort: 9 patients, mean (+/- SEM) age 37 +/- 3 years (Methods)

sex.Description: Gender as reported in Supplementary Table S1 (cohort: 4 women, 5 men; Methods)

epilepsy_duration.Description: Epilepsy duration in years (Supplementary Table S1, 'Epilepsy duration (years)')

epilepsy_pathology.Description: Epilepsy pathology (Supplementary Table S1; FCD = focal cortical dysplasia)

group.Description: Patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing iEEG monitoring for localisation of the seizure onset zone before surgery at the Motol Epilepsy Center, Prague; all had normal or corrected-to-normal vision (Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Methods)

n_bipolar_channels.Description: Number of bipolar channels (adjacent-contact pairs) in this subject's release file after the authors removed faulty contacts and contacts in the seizure onset zone / heterotopic cortex (Zenodo 13712628, data.label). Derived from the release.

n_electrode_labels.Description: Number of distinct electrode labels (letter prefix of the channel names, e.g. 'A' in 'A1-A2'; suffix 'd'/'s' included where present) among the released bipolar channels. Derived from the release. The paper states that 11 to 15 electrodes were implanted per patient; label counts above 15 (sub-P1, sub-P2, sub-P3, sub-P9) are not explained by the source.

n_channels_mni_left.Description: Number of released bipolar channels whose authors' MNI x coordinate (channelInfo.MNI_x) is negative (left hemisphere in MNI space). Derived from the release; see README caveat for sub-P9.

n_channels_mni_right.Description: Number of released bipolar channels whose authors' MNI x coordinate (channelInfo.MNI_x) is positive (right hemisphere in MNI space). Derived from the release.
